description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Annie''' gains [[File:Magic penetration icon.svg|15px|link=Magic penetration]] magic penetration.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Annie''' summons [[File:TibbersSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Tibbers|An icon representing Tibbers]] [[Tibbers]] to the target location in a burst of flame, dealing magic damage to enemies near him. ''Summon: Tibbers'' can be recast at any time while [[File:TibbersSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Tibbers|An icon representing Tibbers]] [[Tibbers]] is alive.
description2.text: Active: Annie summons Tibbers to the target location in a burst of flame, dealing magic damage to enemies near him. Summon: Tibbers can be recast at any time while Tibbers is alive.

description3.raw: [[File:TibbersSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Tibbers|An icon representing Tibbers]] [[Tibbers]] then remains on the field as a controllable [[File:Summon Tibbers.png|20px|link=Pets|An icon representing the keyword Pet]] [[:Pets|pet]] for up to 45 seconds.
description3.text: Tibbers then remains on the field as a controllable pet for up to 45 seconds.

description4.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Annie''' directs [[File:TibbersSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Tibbers|An icon representing Tibbers]] [[Tibbers]] to the target location.
description4.text: Recast: Annie directs Tibbers to the target location.

description5.raw: ''Summon: Tibbers' recast can be used while affected by [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Disrupting|An icon representing the keyword Cast-inhibiting crowd control]] [[:Crowd_control#Disrupting|cast-inhibiting crowd control]]. See [[Annie#Pets|Pets]] for more details about [[File:TibbersSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Tibbers|An icon representing Tibbers]] [[Tibbers]].''
description5.text: Summon: Tibbers' recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control. See Pets for more details about Tibbers.

leveling2.raw:
'''Initial Magic Damage:'''
150 / 212.5 / 275 / 337.5 / 400 (+ 75% AP)

notes.raw: * Only the initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]]. ** Recasting the ability does, however, count as casting an ultimate ability for the purposes of [[File:Experimental Hexplate item.png|20xpx|border|link=Experimental Hexplate|An icon for the item Experimental Hexplate]] [[Experimental Hexplate|Experimental Hexplate's]] [[Named item effect#Overdrive|Overdrive]] and similar effects.(bug) ** PENDING FOR TEST: What about [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]]? * The active deals [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]]. * Tibbers will [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blink]] back next to '''Annie''' if he gets too far away. * Recasting ''Summon: Tibbers'' does not interrupt [[File:Recall.png|20xpx|border|link=Recall|An icon representing Recall]] [[Recall|Recall's]] channel.
notes.text:
Only the initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade.
* Recasting the ability does, however, count as casting an ultimate ability for the purposes of Experimental Hexplate's Overdrive and similar effects.(bug)
* PENDING FOR TEST: What about Force Pulse's?
The active deals area damage.
Tibbers will blink back next to Annie if he gets too far away.
Recasting Summon: Tibbers does not interrupt Recall's channel.
